notes.title: UPDATE 3 OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30619121/8c54215585364fa702b289ebcdff3df015e94d87.png[/img]

[h2]Hey all![/h2]

We’re very excited to [b]announce that Rover Builder’s third major update is live right now![/b] Update three brings a slew of new features, fixes, and levels. See below for a full breakdown!

[h3]Major additions/updates:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]6 brand new levels added[/b]
[*] A new [b]sculptable sand object[/b] in the level editor + [b]a cactus model and a new large rock model[/b]
[*] Track wheels + tracks: a new part that makes it possible to make tank-style vehicles. Tracks operate much better on sand compared to regular wheels
[*] A water gun: [b]a new weapon that sprays water[/b], suitable for close combat. Can pop incoming water balloons for defense purposes.
[*] Water rocket: a new tool/weapon. In rocket mode, it produces thrust (for a little while, it has limited fuel) and enables short hops and/or acceleration boosts. In weapon, mode acts as a single-use rocket [b]launcher that will explode when hitting something.[/b]
[*] A duplicate tool for rover/level editors: Alt+drag now duplicates and moves the selection. In the rover editor Split/Join is renamed to Cut/Join and works with the C key (previously Alt)
[*] [b]Move tool refactor[/b]: it's now possible to move only selected parts, compared to before when it always moved everything that's connected to the moving part.
[*] Steam achievements: [b]There are now many achievements[/b] based on statistics about the gameplay. More will be added in future updates.
[/list]
[h3]Minor updates/fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Wheels now take their orientation based on the building area, not the beam it's attached to
[*] [b]Level details[/b] now have info about the number of objects, vertices, etc.
[*] An objective text is now displayed at the beginning of each mission (in the top bar)
[*] Bug and performance fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes: Level Editor update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

A small patch has been implemented with the following changes:

- Active mesh triangulation when moving faces/vertices 
- Pressing Alt while moving faces/vertices or drawing elevation/grass objects will now snap to a global grid (easy geometric shapes etc). The grid step has been halved to make it more useful
- Camera toggle action added to the rovers
- When merging vertices by ctrl-snapping they will now be actually merged into 1 vertex instead of just being 2 vertices in the same location

Our next Rover tutorial will be with you soon. Till then, keep sharing your creations with us, we love to see them.

notes.title: Terraforma Update - Out Now!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey Builders!
[/h2]
We are so happy to finally bring you the Rover Builder: Terraforma update. Check out the trailer with the new features below:

[previewyoutube=tLhRGxJehr4;full][/previewyoutube]

We have already teased and showcased a bunch of new content you are getting with this patch - so we can't wait to see what you do with all these new tools at your disposal! The biggest edition is of course Level Editor - where you can build fully playable maps and missions from scratch - using all of the tools we used to create the missions that are already in-game. We also have a batch of new levels and missions available to play. Terraforma is our biggest update yet - so make sure to tag @RoverBuilder on [url=https://twitter.com/RoverBuilder]Twitter[/url] so we can see all your new creations - go get building! 

We plan to continually add to this list of new features as we continue in early access - with more editing and building options, more tools, parts and objects available to you. This is only the beginning. 

[u][h1]--------PATCH NOTES--------[/h1]
[/u]
[h3]Level Editor [/h3]
[list]
    [*] Move, Rotate and Scale tools. (work in both object and mesh edit modes)
    [*] Global & Local toggle
    [*] Object Edit mode (Select, Transform, Delete)
    [*] Toggle: Static, Detachable, Breakable
[/list]
[h3]Mesh Edit mode [/h3]
[list]
    [*] Transform vertices and faces
    [*] Vertex snapping (by pressing Ctrl while moving vertices)
    [*] Extrude faces
    [*] Loop Cut
    [*] Sculpt grass height
[/list]
[h3]Add Objects mode [/h3]
[list]
    [*] Mission objects (Spawn boxes, pad, box, magnet box)
    [*] Trees (pine, spruce, bush)
    [*] Rocks (3 x regular, slab, stone ramp)
    [*] Enemies (turret + tanks)
    [*] Fences & bridges (fence, ramp, bridge)
    [*] Props (pencil, eraser, sharpener, ruler, stapler, tape, cup)
    [*] Build (nail, screw, angle)
    [*] Toys (wooden toy blocks)
    [*] Decorations (wall lamp, door, window, wall arrow, wall rectangle, arrow, rectangle)
    [*] Misc (pillar)
[/list]
[h3]Tools [/h3]
[list]
    [*] Draw Elevation tool - extrusion tool for making flat, elevated plywood surfaces
    [*] Draw grass tool + modification tools
    [*] Night/Day slider
    [*] "Always on" function - create automations
    [*] "Level Editor" tag - by using this tag, makes designs available in level editor
    [*] Undo/Redo actions
    [*] Save/Load/Share level functions
    [*] Level Settings: name, tags, description, goal, time limit, workshop sharing options
[/list]
[h3]Quality of Life changes[/h3]
[list]
    [*] Cannon joints are now a little bit stronger and don't break off as easily
    [*] Pause screen now has "open in level editor" button for self made levels
    [*] Mirroring now works based on the central unit, not the building area center
    [*] Wheel placement direction is now based on the building area, not the beam orientation. 
    [*] Menu tab navigation now smoother
    [*] Menu level/rover preview loading optimized
    [*] Save button status indicators added when saving rovers/levels
    [*] Fixed hinge rotation bug
    [*] Fix mirror selection bug  
[/list]

As always, thank you for supporting us during Early Access - this is just update 2 of many - so we have plenty more content to come.

notes.title: Rover Builder - Major Update Out Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30619121/5ab827f401cecfb98acd0edc8d0f4af35092d1be.png[/img]

There's [b]never been[/b] a better moment to  jump back into [b]Rover Builder![/b] The first of five massive updates to the vehicle building simulator drops today [b]containing[/b] [b]new levels, improvements and bug fixes.[/b]

[h2]So What Exactly Is Featured In Update One?[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]New and improved rover editor[/b] with new components including cannons, magnets, solar panels and more!

[*] [b]12 brand new levels[/b], designed, curated and tailored to take advantage of Rover Builder's new components and materials.

[*] [b]Brand new rover sharing[/b] section allows you to download and share custom-made rovers with the Rover Builder community around the world.

[*] [b]New tutorial mode[/b] provides newcomers the ability to learn how to create your first rover. 

[*] [b]Bug fixes[/b] to help with game stability. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30619121/25e819009075644d35b63bba35b2d479c4afd924.gif[/img]

[h2]Engineer, Problem Solve, Destroy - Overcome.[/h2]

In Rover Builder, you will be tasked with solving increasingly challenging missions.[b] From retrieve and return collection missions, to traversing difficult terrain and combatting AI enemies,[/b] you'll need to make sure the Rover's you build are up to the challenge!
 
[b]Rover Editor[/b] makes the building process easy with [b]three levels of creation:[/b]
 
[list]
[*] [b]Central Unit[/b] - the core supplying power to your rover, if parts lose connection, or the central unit takes damage, your rover will become ineffective 

[*] [b]Materials[/b] - create the structure for your build, containing wooden beams, hydraulics, springs, tracks and more

[*] [b]Parts & Components[/b] - kit out your rover to face any challenge, add wheels, weapons, tools, weights and more that can be controlled with custom keystroke programming
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30619121/9cc12a2cd986ca87fe869122d403170ddb0dc78b.gif[/img]

[h2]Have Total Freedom Over Your Environment [/h2]

[b]Create custom levels [/b]in the hard surface 3D modelling Level Editor! Sculpt your landscape with mesh editing mode, [b]add trees, rocks, grass[/b] and then implement your challenges using the likes of [b]magnets, turrets and props[/b] in object edit mode!
 
[b]Level Editor[/b] also includes:
 
[list]
[*] [b]Day/Night slider [/b]to create dark and light levels.

[*] [b]Draw Elevation tool[/b] for easy raised or sunken surface creation.

[*] [b]Custom Stage Rules[/b] including rover parts, time limits, goals and more.

[*] [b]Level sharing.[/b]

[*] NPC Rovers[b] with automatic aiming and shooting.[/b]

[*] [b]and lots more![/b]
[/list]

We will be bringing 5 huge updates to revolutionise Rover Builder in the lead up to launch. [b]Early access players will gain access to each update as they are released, adding tons of new features, parts and abilities![/b]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30619121/9937bf11ed538e7faad46bc65b368445b52d211f.jpg[/img]

Stay tuned for [b]four more[/b] [b]huge updates[/b] planned by joining our [url=https://discord.com/invite/Y8bgV5QCHW?utm_source=sendinblue&utm_campaign=Rover_Builder__Announcement__PQube&utm_medium=email]discord[/url] group, and share your builds, provide feedback or pick up tips and tricks from the community!

notes.title: Rover Builder Update - Plate material, new tutorial
notes.notes:
We just shipped an update! Here’s what’s new:

There’s a new Plate material! Basically it’s sheets of (breakable) material that you can build from existing steel beams. It attaches to the middle of the beam, and breaks apart if one or more connections fail. The broken pieces vanish after 10 seconds. You can make all kinds of stuff with it: cart floors, scoops, bridge vehicles, decorations etc. Get creative!

There’s now a completely new tutorial that’s not a single video with narration. Instead it’s a slideshow of auto-repeating short clips with texts that you can navigate as you like. The tutorial guides the player through building a rover with a rotating scoop. The tutorial is displayed in the top corner so that you can build along while the tutorial is playing! Unfortunately we made the new tutorial before adding the plate material so it’s missing from there :P Oh well.

Other fixes:
[list]
[*]The steel parts (beams, plates) now have considerably less friction against [*]the ground to improve stability
[*]Fixed a bug where pressing O while writing the name of the rover in the [*]Gallery opened the options menu (if a part was selected)
[*]A couple other bug fixes

notes.title: Rover Builder update - New planet, new tools!
notes.notes:
The 3rd planet is here! You get to fly with rockets on this snowy planet, trying to complete the missions with limited fuel. Can you do it?

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30619121/b88d11796f0818b5d8e3c9eda7b034328b8c808f.jpg[/img]

The central unit now has damage, so you have to complete the mission without destroying the unit. The unit is relatively strong. The damage was added mostly to prevent being able to slam to the telepad with high speed (in the rocket planet) and still get the mission completed even though the rover is obliterated. You also have to wait for a couple seconds on the pad in the traveling missions.

There’s also 2 new tools: Split and Join. With Split (shortcut: Alt) you can split a steel beam in 2 or more pieces that are connected together. You can then e.g. remove the unwanted part. Very handy for shortening steel beams without having to delete the whole beam, or cutting parts of the rover off to be moved with the Move tool. You can also join 2 parallel&connected steel beams together by selecting both of them and pressing the Join button (or J key).

The driving camera is now fully rewritten, to make it more intuitive and less jittery. The camera now rotates so that it always keeps the rover dead centered, i.e. no more weird swinging when rotating the viewpoint while driving. There was also a stuttering problem with the camera’s movement (when the rover was going fast), and that’s also fixed.

Other changes/additions:
- There’s now a music mute button in the menu
- Rover Gallery now has custom naming for rovers

notes.title: Rover Builder update - New planet, new tools!
notes.notes:
The 3rd planet is here! You get to fly with rockets on this snowy planet, trying to complete the missions with limited fuel. Can you do it?

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30619121/b88d11796f0818b5d8e3c9eda7b034328b8c808f.jpg[/img]

The central unit now has damage, so you have to complete the mission without destroying the unit. The unit is relatively strong. The damage was added mostly to prevent being able to slam to the telepad with high speed (in the rocket planet) and still get the mission completed even though the rover is obliterated. You also have to wait for a couple seconds on the pad in the traveling missions.

There’s also 2 new tools: Split and Join. With Split (shortcut: Alt) you can split a steel beam in 2 or more pieces that are connected together. You can then e.g. remove the unwanted part. Very handy for shortening steel beams without having to delete the whole beam, or cutting parts of the rover off to be moved with the Move tool. You can also join 2 parallel&connected steel beams together by selecting both of them and pressing the Join button (or J key).

The driving camera is now fully rewritten, to make it more intuitive and less jittery. The camera now rotates so that it always keeps the rover dead centered, i.e. no more weird swinging when rotating the viewpoint while driving. There was also a stuttering problem with the camera’s movement (when the rover was going fast), and that’s also fixed.

Other changes/additions:
- There’s now a music mute button in the menu
- Rover Gallery now has custom naming for rovers
- Tutorial video is now hopefully less laggy (a completely new tutorial coming 
soon!)
- Selecting, deleting and part placing are now also mirrored when mirroring is 
turned on
- Many small bugfixes

notes.title: Rover Builder update - Slider part (previously steering), move tool and keybind display
notes.notes:
We just shipped an update! Here's what's new:

The old steering part is now rebranded as a Slider part. It looks the same, but has a lot of new functionality:
[list]
[*]There’s now a “motored”-option. It’s checked by default, but if you uncheck it the slider will just slide freely across the whole steel beam it’s attached to. Lots of new possibilities!
[*]There’s now a couple options for the motored mode:
     - Movement range: you can now define how long you want the slider’s movement to be
     - Motor speed: Lets you control how fast the movement is
     - Return to center: Checked by default. If unchecked, the slider will just leave where it is after you stop pressing the movement keys, without returning to the center. This opens up a whole new world of cranes, balancing systems, active suspensions etc!
[*]The sliders can now be placed directly above each other for more compact slider systems (before the gears would’ve gotten in the way)
[*]You can now flip the sliders sideways on the axis of the steel beam, for more flexible placing
[/list]

Another new thing is the updated toolbar in top left corner of the building mode. There’s now a selection tool, and a move tool. The selection tool works like the rectangular selection has worked before, but the move tool is new.

Right now the move tool will only move everything that’s attached to the part you’re moving, so it’s not yet possible to only move selected parts. However you can disconnect e.g. a steering system from the rest of the build and move it independently. The moving works in 90 degree angles. Keep in mind that the mirroring plane will not move with the central box, so there’s center lines visible in the grid while you move, to help to keep the rover centered.

Shortcut for moving is Ctrl.

(We are working on a splitting/joining tool for steel beams, which will also make it a lot easier to disconnect certain parts of the build for moving. Hopefully that makes it to the next update)

The selection logic has also changed a bit. Now you need to have the selection tool active to select multiple parts, otherwise only the last clicked part will get selected. This basically means you have to hold Shift to select multiple parts when e.g. the steel material is active. (as the shortcut will temporarily activate the selection tool)

There’s now a panel that shows all the different parts’ keybindings in the building and driving mode. You can minimize it by clicking the little arrow in the top left of the panel. The keys will also act as clickable buttons in driving mode. We are planning to add more functionality to this panel in the future, but right now it’s mainly a place to easily see all the key commands.

Other smaller changes/fixes:
[list]
[*]The wheel joints are now a bit stronger, so they don’t fall off as easily
[*]The wheels now have a little less friction, which should help with overall stability and skid steering. It also feels more natural.
[*]There’s now a confirmation box when loading/removing rover designs. You can choose to not show it again.
[*]In the launcher window’s “input” tab there’s now some more relevant keybindings to modify
[*]Left/Right arrow keys reversed for the horizontal rotation of the camera in building mode
[*]Fixed a bug where the mission scene would get messed up if you clicked Start repeatedly
[/list]

We are working on making the steel joints a bit more durable with bigger structures, but it’s still a work in progress and there’s no big updates on that yet. The physics have gone through some refactoring already though, so hopefully you’ll see a little less explosions with this update already!

notes.title: Rover Builder update - Sandbox mode with rockets
notes.notes:
We just shipped an update! Here's what's new:

Sandbox Mode:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30619121/735d92b6f6aeec143dfd358bdc589cde7c661088.jpg[/img]
[list]
    [*]A brand new mode that you can find in the mission menu (in the player information box)
    [*]White, flat and clean environment for testing designs without having to start a mission everytime
    [*]New Rocket part in the sandbox mode! Pretty self-explanatory, a part that provides thrust with Space key by default. As of now you can't use this in the existing planets, there will be a rocket planet in the future. We just wanted to already let you play with it in the Sandbox :) In the missions rockets will have limited fuel, but Sandbox has infinite fuel.
    [*]"Drop a box" -feature that drops a random box behind the rover, so that you can easily test lifters
    [*]Sandbox mode is also ideal for stylish screencasts!
[/list]

UI / Usability features:
[list]
    [*]The driving camera is now easier to rotate around
    [*]Rectangular selection tool (Shift+LMB) in the building mode: selects everything that's inside the rectangle, also parts hidden behind other parts
    [*]Camera now rotates with arrow keys in building mode
    [*]Other new shortcuts in building mode: F = Flip, O = Options, +/- = Zoom
    [*]Options-menu tweaks: better handling for situations where there's multiple parts' options shown
    [*]Double-clicking a part now opens the Options-menu
    [*]Rover Gallery scrolling now works properly
    [*]Disconnected parts are no longer removed when driving/saving

notes.title: Minor Update - Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Another small bugfix update while we work on new features.

- Fixed a bug where steering boxes could be placed partially on top of existing ones
- Fixed a bug where motors would disappear if they had a wheel attached close to them
- Fixed a bug where the teleport option wouldn't show up if the central box was too high up
- Added a missing collider to a stone pillar in planet2 mission5

- Added WASD (+QE) shortcuts for camera movement in the building mode
- Added Esc shortcuts for opening and closing different menu's
